scope: Existing visible guide data was retained unless a current primary/community source established a necessary correction. This report is for maintenance and is intentionally not rendered as per-card source clutter.

entries.version_or_context: Current wiki.gg curio data module; vanilla, Crimson Court and Color of Madness entries shown by this guide
entries.notes: Existing 90-card count and warning ordering were preserved. Quest-only cards remain explicitly labelled.
Courtyard is an Epic-length Bloodlight expedition; Farmstead uses wave fights without normal room corridors. Existing guide wording remains compatible.

entries.version_or_context: Fire's Edge Retail build 27987, 2026-09-14; hero skill recommendations rechecked 2026-10-30
entries.notes: Added the Runaway and Duelist to the offline expedition planner. Runaway recommendations use her seven original-game skills and rank legality; Duelist is marked as the exception that equips all seven combat skills, including the free Anticipation stance switch. Recommendations distinguish normal expeditions from boss fights and retain the Retail 27987 balance baseline. Official notes confirm the live Duelist/Riposte, Touché, Feint, Disengage, Flèche and Runaway balance changes.

entries.item: Sunward Isles curio and region material
entries.version_or_context: Korean field-test record cross-checked with the published Workshop curio changelog on 2026-10-29
entries.notes: Updated Ho-oh, Kuchisake Onna, Old Shrine, Yanagi Baba, Run-down Shack, Forgotten Incense, Unremembered Scriptures, Lost Cargo, Barrel of Blades, Old Shrine Bell and Abandoned Palaquin. Ho-oh now records the published 25% max-HP / -25 stress result; Kuchisake Onna uses Major Omamori. Effects not established by those records remain explicitly marked as confirmation-needed rather than guessed.
The mod describes added curios, but a current public individual name/effect list was not established. Its overview card remains separate from the verified 90-card count.
